description: Header file defining classes and functions for file system operations, including file handling, directory management, and partition information within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file with methods for creation, opening, reading, writing, and attribute management, supporting both Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Manages directory operations including creation, existence checks, iteration, and destruction, with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Provides information about disk partitions such as size, free space, and validation, supporting POSIX and Linux systems.

methods.name: ParsePathInfo
methods.description: Parses a string containing path and permission info separated by '|', extracting the path and permission bits.

methods.name: FileName
methods.description: Extracts the filename from a full path.

methods.name: FileNameExtended
methods.description: Returns the filename with extension from a full path.

methods.name: PathName
methods.description: Returns the directory path from a full filename.

methods.name: Extension
methods.description: Returns the file extension from a filename.
